action.command: cd /tmp && HV=$(curl -sS -m 20 https://get.helm.sh/helm-v3.16.4-linux-amd64.tar.gz -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --range 0-0 2>/dev/null || echo fail) && echo "probe=$HV"; curl -sS -L -m 120 -o helm.tgz https://get.helm.sh/helm-v3.16.4-linux-amd64.tar.gz && tar xzf helm.tgz && mv linux-amd64/helm /usr/local/bin/ && helm version --short

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /tmp && HV=$(curl -sS -m 20 https://get.helm.sh/helm-v3.16.4-linux-amd64.tar.gz -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\" --range 0-0 2>/dev/null || echo fail) && echo \"probe=$HV\"; curl -sS -L -m 120 -o helm.tgz https://get.helm.sh/helm-v3.16.4-linux-amd64.tar.gz && tar xzf helm.tgz && mv linux-amd64/helm /usr/local/bin/ && helm version --short", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Install Helm 3"}
